title: Games made in godot engine do not work. I cannot find help for my issue.
body:
### Tested versions

Newest updates for all of these games, all of them on steam except for a couple that are from gamejolt or itch.io.

### System information

windows 11, Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-9400F CPU @ 2.90GHz (2.90 GHz), 32.0 GB of ram, NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Ti.

### Issue description

Games like webfishing, case of the golden idol, a bite at freddies, deltarune, undertale, FAITH, and any other game made in godot engine will do the same thing. Games with much higher quality, such as God of War, Ghost of Tsushima, and Spiderman, will all run perfectly fine.

The problematic games will either not launch at all, or will boot up, run extremely slow, and then start "not responding"
Nvidia and windows are both updated, i have uninstalled the games, verified files, played them in admin mode, and nothing has worked.
I havent been able to find a single person with the same issue as me, i had to make a github account just for this.

its probably important to mention that these games will *sometimes* work. Deltarune for example, launched and i was able to play for an hour before it crashed, and it would crash every other time i opened it, a couple days later i was able to open it again, and the same thing happened. Same thing with case of the golden idol.

I know nothing about Godot, and i am not very tech smart, so i have no idea what could be causing the issue, and i havent been able to find any help or solution.

### Steps to reproduce

Starting the game causes the error.
